test_unconstrained_affine_properties: test that UnconstrainedAffine has is_constant_jacobian and is_constant_log_det properties set to True
test_invalid_bijector_parameters: test that UnconstrainedAffine raises ValueError for non-square matrices or mismatched bias shapes
test_batched_forward_inverse: test forward_and_log_det and inverse_and_log_det with various batched matrix, bias, and input shapes
test_identity_initialization: test that an identity matrix and zero bias bijector returns inputs unchanged with zero log determinant
test_inverse_roundtrip: test that inverse_and_log_det recovers the original input and logdet_fwd equals negative logdet_inv
